interpretation: Player offers the guard the same 15 gold again after he refused it once.

modifiers.label: guard still stinging from the earlier insult

narration_on_success: He exhales hard through his nose, snatches the coin, and drops the key in your palm without meeting your eyes.
narration_on_failure: He goes rigid, hand drifting to his belt. "I said no. Ask again and see what happens."
